projects.description: Developed a robust Face Liveliness Detection system leveraging the face-recognition package and OpenCV to accurately identify users, prevent spoofing attempts, and enhance overall authentication security. Integrated real-time face detection and verification with live camera input to reliably distinguish between dynamic human faces and static spoofing images, improving system security and authentication accuracy. Applied the solution within the context of secure authentication systems, effectively demonstrating expertise in Python programming, advanced computer vision techniques, and AI-driven security solutions.

Developed a fully functional real-time chat application that allows users to engage in instant messaging with smooth, responsive interactions, incorporating features for efficient message delivery and enhanced experience. Implemented secure user authentication and private messaging features, ensuring that all conversations remain fully confidential, accessible only to authorized users, and protected against unauthorized access. Designed a clean and modern user interface with interactive features such as online/offline indicators, typing status, and persistent chat history, providing a seamless, intuitive, and highly user-friendly messaging experience.

Built a Multi-Agent RAG Chatbot with LangChain, ChromaDB & NVIDIA NIM — routing queries across 3 specialized AI agents using local cosine similarity with ~2ms latency. Solo-built an end-to-end AI chatbot covering data prep, embedding generation, semantic routing, RAG orchestration, and a live Streamlit UI, deployed for Chennai Institute of Technology to handle Admissions, Placements, and Career queries.
